title: Plans to Preserve Singapore's Food Heritage
what_it_is: Plans to Preserve Singapore's Food Heritage

sections.label: Deliciously Singaporean exhibition visitors
sections.summary: Over 480,000 people visited the "Deliciously Singaporean" exhibition, showing strong interest in food heritage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Over 480,000 people visited the "Deliciously Singaporean" exhibition, which is a testament to the strong interest people have in discovering our food heritage.

sections.label: SG50 Fund food campaigns
sections.summary: The SG50 Celebration Fund supported "jiaksimi" and the My Singapore Food campaign featuring local recipes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The SG50 Celebration Fund supported "jiaksimi" and the My Singapore Food campaign, which featured local food recipes contributed by renowned food chefs and food enthusiasts.

sections.label: Geylang Serai heritage trail
sections.summary: NHB partnered grassroots organisations and the Inter-Racial and Religious Confidence Circle for a Geylang Serai Foot and Food Heritage Trail.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: For instance, NHB partnered grassroots organisations as well as the Inter-Racial and Religious Confidence Circle to put together a Geylang Serai Foot and Food Heritage Trail, which highlights not just historical places but also food delights from famous stalls along Geylang Road and the Haig Road Food Centre.

sections.label: Singapore HeritageFest 2016 initiatives
sections.summary: Singapore HeritageFest 2016 will feature initiatives by the younger generation to preserve culinary methods and promote food heritage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The upcoming Singapore HeritageFest 2016 will also feature more initiatives by the younger generation to preserve traditional culinary methods and promote our food heritage.

sections.label: Hawker food licensing and heritage
sections.summary: Hawker licensees in NEA-managed centres must be citizens or PRs and cannot employ foreigners, with affordability and accessibility also important.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Dr Lim mentioned about who can cook local hawker food.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: I think it is already the case today that hawker stall licensees in NEA-managed hawker centres and markets have to be Singapore Citizens or PRs, and they are also not allowed to employ foreigners.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: But we do so recognising that other factors are also very important and these also help to make Singapore hawker food very close to our hearts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: This includes affordability and accessibility, and it also includes allowing for evolution of recipes, so that there will be innovation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Our approach is to promote our food heritage in the ways that I have mentioned just now, rather than advocating further restrictions on who can cook hawker food in privately-managed food centres.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: As for the example of Penang that Dr Lim mentioned, I think it is an interesting experiment and we will certainly watch it as it unfolds.
